status: Early Access Phase 2 (scheduled through end of September 2026)

login.key_registration: Open OnDemand web portal -> launch 'SSH Public Key' -> paste public key under 'Add a Public Key'

partitions.name: gpu
partitions.description: The only partition; all 400 GB200 NVL4 compute nodes

compute_node.cpu: Grace CPU x2, LPDDR5X 960 GiB total (768 GB/s total, 384 GB/s per CPU)
compute_node.gpu: NVIDIA B200 x4, HBM3e 692.8 GiB total (173.2 GiB per GPU, 31.6 TB/s total)
compute_node.cpu_gpu_bandwidth: NVLink-C2C, 450 GB/s bidirectional (cache-coherent - CPU and GPU can access each other's memory)
compute_node.interconnect: InfiniBand XDR, 800 Gbps x4 per node; two-layer Fat Tree (6 spine switches, 17 leaf switches; 16 leaves x24 nodes + 1 leaf x16 nodes)
compute_node.local_scratch_per_node: Kioxia XD7P NVMe SSD, 7.68 TB, ~7.2 GB/s read / 4.8 GB/s write

job_resources.note: Node count, max CPU cores/node, and max memory/node all follow deterministically from the requested GPU count (4 GPUs/node) - see table.

home.quota_note: 5 GB is genuinely small — dotfiles, small scripts, and configuration only. Anything resembling a dataset, checkpoint, or build output belongs in the group area (/data1/GROUP, 1 TB) instead. Confirm live with the check_quota_cmd below if in doubt, rather than assuming.

scratch.access: owner only, from the node running the job
scratch.purged: deleted when the job finishes - copy results out before the job ends

available.name: nvhpc
available.description: Standard NVIDIA HPC SDK environment including MPI

available.name: nvhpc-nompi
available.description: NVIDIA HPC SDK without MPI, for bringing your own MPI

available.name: nvhpc-hpcx
available.description: nvhpc combined with HPC-X, for HPC-X MPI over InfiniBand/RDMA

available.name: nvhpc-hpcx-cuda13
available.description: Same as nvhpc-hpcx but with CUDA version fixed to CUDA 13

modules.note: Exact versions (e.g. 26.3) change over time - query live with 'module avail' rather than hardcoding a version.

spack.note: GPU-enabled software list can be updated by the system - always confirm with 'spack find -x' rather than trusting this static list alone. Loading a GPU package does not itself allocate GPUs - request them in the Slurm job (#SBATCH --gpus=N).

account_application: RIKYU Account Application System (RAAS); Early Access Phase 2 is available to ARiSE users, members of accepted SPReAD1000 projects, and RIKEN members.
